forward_patch:
--- original
+++ modified
@@ -0,0 +1,21 @@
+---
+assignees:
+- claude-code
+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: '80'
+title: 'getSymbol: resolve a module-qualified query (`module.Name`) to `Name` in file or directory `module`'
+---
+## What
+A `X.Name` query (Python `module.Class`) that finds no class `X` gives an empty result now, and its near candidates are wrong. Add a `module` match tier. It runs after `inherited` and before `caseInsensitive`. It splits the query on `.` into a module part and a symbol part, and matches each candidate whose qualified path is the symbol part and whose file path, with the extension removed, has the module part's segments as a contiguous run of path components. So the file stem matches (`startapp.py`, `startapp.swift`, `startapp.rs`) and so does a module directory (`startapp/__init__.py`, `Sources/startapp/x.swift`). Every split is tried, so `commands.startapp.Command` and `startapp.Command.handle` work too.
+
+## Evidence
+SWE-bench run nokanban24b (2026-11-07), django__django-14382, session 01M6W1YS4MJ963KK2KQ4SQKG0C: `getSymbol({query:"startapp.Command"})` gave `symbols:[]`, the note said "No class named \"startapp\"", and the candidates were test classes. The real class is `class Command(TemplateCommand)` in django/core/management/commands/startapp.py.
+
+## Code
+Sources/FoundationModelsCodeContext/Ops/SymbolOps.swift: `getSymbol`, the new `matchModule`, and the new `SymbolMatchTier.module`.
+
+## Acceptance
+- [ ] `startapp.Command` resolves to `Command` in `django/core/management/commands/startapp.py` with tier `.module`; a `Command` in another file is not returned
+- [ ] A dotted module (`commands.startapp.Command`) and a member (`startapp.Command.handle`) resolve
+- [ ] A module directory (`pkg/__init__.py` or `pkg/x.py`) resolves `pkg.Name`
+- [ ] Tests in SymbolOpsTests, failing first #bug
\ No newline at end of file
